$schema_note: Shape-only fixture for agent-auth v2. Not production secrets.

fields.PATH: decoded URL path matching Go r.URL.Path (decodeURIComponent of WHATWG pathname)
fields.empty_query_slot: literal empty between second and third pipe — query params forbidden on authority routes
fields.bodyHash: lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact request body bytes; empty body uses SHA-256 of zero bytes

encoding.X-Agent-Signature: base64 Ed25519 signature over preimage UTF-8 bytes

key_file_shape.alt: raw base64 private key seed (32 bytes) — public derived

example_preimage_parts.note: bodyHash = sha256(utf8(body)).hex().lower(); headers built from preimage only

constraints: sign exact body bytes that will be sent (string or Uint8Array)
forbid non-empty query string on authority URLs
redirect: error — never replay authority across redirects
signing path is decoded, not percent-encoded
